The '''Prince of Novoanov''' is a noble title associated with the 1352 constitutional crisis in the [[Duchy of Ledostrov]].

== 1352 Crisis ==

After deposing an ineffective duke, the noble council chose the Prince of Novoanov as the new ruler. The choice was conditional on the creation of a permanent decision-making body, resulting in the [[Anavaisk-Novoanov Accords]] and the [[Duma of Ledostrov]].

== Legacy ==

The title became associated with Ledostrov's shift from a more personal ducal order toward a constitutional duchy mediated by noble assemblies.
